A Miami Beach boutique, online only

MiamiMuseBoutique has been selling women's clothing on Etsy for six years — no storefront, no fuss, just a tightly curated rack of beach-to-night pieces shipped from Miami Beach, Florida.

  • 949 sales through the Etsy shop
  • 4.5-star average across 164 customer reviews
  • Most pieces $40–$68 — vacation style without the resort markup
  • Online only — shop any time, from anywhere

Good to know

The essentials before you shop.

Where do I buy?

Everything is sold through the MiamiMuseBoutique shop on Etsy. Tap any “Shop on Etsy” button on this page to go straight there.

How much do pieces cost?

Most items in the shop are priced between $40 and $68. Check each Etsy listing for the exact price of the piece you love.

Is there a physical store I can visit?

No — MiamiMuseBoutique is online only, based in Miami Beach, FL. There is no storefront address or phone number; the fastest way to reach the shop is by email or through Etsy.

How do I ask about sizing or an order?

Email the shop at MiamiMuseBoutique@gmail.com, or message through Etsy where order details live.

Say hello

Questions about a piece, sizing, or an order? The boutique is online only, so email is the way in — or message the shop directly on Etsy.
